qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the universal joint connecting the propeller shaft to transmission on all BMW E30 models?

How does the torque specification differ between E32/E34/E36/E39 models and M3/M5 models for M12 10.9 screws?
qa_pairs.answer: E32/E34/E36/E38/E39 models require 100 Nm, while M3/M5 models require 115 Nm for M12 10.9 screws.
